sloka: पुरा त्रेतायुगे राम बभूव बहुविस्तरम् ।समन्ताद्योजनशतं विमृगं पक्षिवर्जितम् ।। ७.७७.१ ॥
transliteration: purā tretāyuge rāma babhūva bahuvistaram ।samantādyojanaśataṁ vimṛgaṁ pakṣivarjitam ।। 7.77.1 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, formerly in the Treta Yuga, there was a very extensive area, a hundred yojanas all around, that was devoid of both animals and birds.
